name: acep-studio
description: Autonomous Controller Evolution Platform (ACEP) Web App & MATLAB Suite

scripts.serve: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const mime={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.md':'text/markdown'}; http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let p=path.join(__dirname, req.url==='/'?'web_app/index.html':(req.url.startsWith('/papers')?req.url:'web_app'+req.url)); if(fs.existsSync(p)){ res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime[path.extname(p)]||'text/plain'}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }else{ res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(8080,()=>console.log('ACEP Studio running at http://localhost:8080'));"

author: ACEP Research Consortium
